name: Purchase Price
rationale: Controls upfront cash/finance exposure and preserves budget headroom.

name: Resale Value / Depreciation
rationale: A liquid UAE secondary market and strong retained value reduce net ownership cost and exit risk.

name: Reliability & Maintainability
rationale: Predictable reliability, service effort and repair cost matter in UAE heat and high-mileage use.

name: Service Network & Parts Availability
rationale: Strong UAE workshop coverage and parts availability reduce downtime.

name: Comfort & NVH
rationale: Seat comfort, ride, cabin noise, HVAC and rear-passenger comfort matter for daily and inter-emirate use.

name: Safety & ADAS
rationale: Passive safety and effective ADAS reduce operational risk in dense urban and highway driving.

name: UAE Climate & Road Suitability
rationale: GCC specification, cooling, tyres/brakes, clearance and heat/dust robustness.

name: Total Cost of Ownership
rationale: Fuel/energy, insurance, service, tyres and registration determine recurring ownership cost.

name: Practicality & Space
rationale: Passenger/cargo capacity, rear-seat usability and loading flexibility.

name: Fuel Economy / Driving Range
rationale: Energy use and practical range affect recurring cost and convenience.

name: Performance & Driveability
rationale: Power delivery, braking, steering, visibility and stability.

name: Technology & Convenience
rationale: Infotainment, smartphone integration, cameras, charging/connectivity and ergonomics.
